DnBOX INSTRUMENTS
SoundsRemoteSamplesProjectsPresetsManualHistoryInstall nightly
Install firmwareImport samples

Songs & projects

Move your whole live project—song arrangement, patterns and sounds—to or from a file. Include samples for a portable copy.

Connect your keyboard

Connect by USB with X0X running. Stop playback, recording and performance mode; close other editors.

Not connected

Not connected.

Inspect or import a project

Inspect a file offline, or connect to prepare an import.

SlotOn keyboardIn projectAction

Import replaces the live project and the sample slots shown above. Save on keyboard stores it immediately; autosave also applies.

Details: import checks

The firmware validates the project before sample changes, verifies the written samples, then adopts the project.

The recovery backup from the interrupted import is still available, even if you close its preview or choose another file.

Export a project

Details: project files

Portable files retain original sample bytes, playback rates and slot order. Without samples, a file imports only when every sample slot already matches.

On the keyboard

Load replaces the live project. Reset clears the song, patterns, sounds and project settings; samples stay. Reset turns autosave on and may overwrite the saved project. Export first to keep your work.

Details: reset & recovery

Reset also clears motion and stops playback and recording; device role settings stay in place. Arrangement-only clear is unavailable in this browser. To clear only the arrangement, use SONG → CLEAR SONG on the keyboard, keeping patterns, sounds, settings and samples.

Keep USB connected during transfers. After a sample-transfer failure, the page attempts to restore the previous samples and reports the result. Keep the recovery file for reconnecting.

MIDI exchange availability

Browser MIDI export is unavailable: no qualified source-executed browser provider is installed. File inspection and the original full-project backup/restore tools remain separate. A local workspace draft is not a native project or MIDI export.

Choose your keyboard and starting breaks.

Choose your keyboard above.

Open current installerInstallation guide

Your sample choices stay in this website preview. The existing installer opens separately; this preview does not write to the keyboard or replace your samples.

First installation and update verification

Firmware installation and bootloader adoption are different operations. Mandatory m-boot is the intended prerequisite; normal adoption is not yet available through this preview. The installer must verify the exact model and package, same instrument, complete backup and durable readback before it can offer a new adoption action.

A completed transfer or reconnect is not proof of a successful boot. Check the exact installed version and confirm controls and sound after an update. Existing user samples and projects must be preserved.
